comparison.objective: Candidate screens dry finishing media from parts; record clears a washbasin blockage and restores drainage.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate tests orientation-dependent rigid-particle passage through open mesh; record tests plunger sealing/actuation and hydraulic blockage displacement.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires ≥98% receiver-contained media with washers retained and no spill; record requires specified drained-water volume, a clear pipe bore and plunger clearance, with damage/leak gates.
comparison.reason: Both involve flow, but one tests dry size separation of free rigid bodies and the other tests hydraulic obstruction removal.
